weights_note: Qualitative ranks, not a fake 0.01 precision. Weighted visual totals are midpoints of independent reviewers (max 2.79/5).

A.name: Refine the latest hybrid
A.visible_quality_ceiling: Low-mid 3/5. Lettering already captured most overlay gains (area 367%→221%; original 32/52 <12px vs hybrid 0). Residual failures are in plates.
evidence: owner still unsatisfied after editorial pass
unknowns: Whether a few hero redraws would change owner affect
leading_indicators: Owner still says not like the bar
A.kill: If 6 redraws do not change blinded preference

B.name: Modular replacement
replace: One weak stage: storyboard/layout OR generation route OR finishing
discard: Per-beat finished-image as the only spine, if layout is the replaced stage
B.visible_quality_ceiling: Unknown; could reach mid 3 if storyboard sticks, or stay 2 if the replaced module is not the bottleneck
evidence: Targeted-edit bm08 proves one module can remove extras
CH01 stage breaks prove layout is the larger hole
B.pilot: Same 14 beats: current hybrid vs storyboard-locked layouts + existing generator
risks: Replacing the generator without layouts repeats pose-assembly
B.rights: If generator stays in-product, provenance still null
leading_indicators: Stage continuity across the action chain
B.kill: If layouts are ignored by the generator on >3/14 panels after one retry
B.scale: Only as a gate into C
B.opportunity_cost: May delay layered production if B is treated as the destination

C.name: Human-directed hybrid rebuild
replace: Finished-image-first spine with storyboard → assets → layered finish; AI only where measured advantage
C.visible_quality_ceiling: Only route with a credible path toward 4/5 on sequential craft; 5/5 not promised
C.likelihood_named_bar: Medium if owner actually staffs acting/action/cleanup; low if 'human-directed' is still one agent plus ImageGen
evidence: USCO Part 2: prompts alone are not authorship
page evidence that overlays cannot restage
unknowns: whether Ember faces survive a line/cel restage
C.pilot: 14-panel frozen benchmark, Ember payload optional, two routes including storyboard-first
C.tooling: Thumbnails; model sheets; optional 3D block; generator for bg/fx/hero only; SVG lettering kept
C.direct_spend: $0 default; paid renderer only if owner authorizes
risks: Owner time is the scarce input; human_minutes currently null
C.rights: Human modification of AI plates is the USCO path to protectable expression; still not commercial clearance
C.reversible: Pilot yes; full rebuild no without cost
leading_indicators: Blind reviewers prefer C-route pages; contact readable without captions; human_minutes recorded
C.kill: If owner will not spend review hours, or if C-route loses blinded comparison
C.scale: One episode only after two independent reviewers + owner prefer it by predeclared margin

D.name: Greenfield restart
retain: Engineering lessons: hashes, nulls, SVG lettering, readers, fail-closed gates, anti-overclaim
discard: Obligation to Ember plates and 24-panel template
D.visible_quality_ceiling: Same as C’s spine; new nouns do not fix pose-assembly
D.likelihood_named_bar: Low if it reuses finished-image-first; medium only with C’s spine and a stronger hook
evidence: City and Borrowed Down already were new IPs and still missed the bar
unknowns: Whether owner dislike is story or craft
D.pilot: Only after a competent Ember storyboard is still rejected
roles: same as C plus new world design
risks: Restarts the noun-churn Ember’s ADR-EL001 closed
Loses the only numeric LitRPG ledger that works
D.rights: Same AI provenance issues unless human-first
leading_indicators: Owner rejects Ember storyboard on premise, not craft

D.scale: New title only after craft is proven on a neutral or Ember payload
